summary: Argument coding alternates between zero-marked human, animal and plant patients, and l-suffixes for the served participant. This variation does not alone justify separate senses.

I.1a combines ecclesiastical service by assistants and priests, without identifying their precise duties. u darbo di dayroyuṯo at 35/4 describes a monastic way of service; it is not automatically a fixed idiom.
Elapsed seven-year kxudamno at 24/196 contrasts with bounded Preterit xdəmluxli at 24/199 and xdəmlan at 40/31. Infectum also occurs with forty-day and year-long narrative intervals.
The Arabic-derived verb is inflected in I; cognate xədme with xdəmluxli (24/199) is an internal object, not independently a light-verb lexical sense.
No new fixed idiom is established by xdəm plus a descriptive service domain. The inherited Russian editorial question and all existing gloss wording are retained.
Confirm the technical subsense's range: should priestly service and assisting at the Messe remain together, and what duties does ʕal iḏe d-u=qašo specify?
What is the function of -li in xodamnoli at 58/23: self-benefactive or a local conjugational extension?
Confirm the contraction and agreement in gxudmalləx (PrS 34/94) and the group suffix -mme in PrS 34/89.
